name: OpenSourceProjects

sources.title: Homepage — live directory of 10,000+ open source projects and alternatives to 740+ commercial products
Submit an open source project — free, no waitlist fees; hand-reviewed

requirements: Genuinely open source — public repository plus a recognized license
Actively maintained — recent commits, not abandoned
Useful to developers; ideally an alternative to a commercial tool or self-hostable
Submission does not guarantee inclusion — every entry is hand-reviewed
preparation: Optional: project website, what it 'Replaces' (commercial product), category, email for follow-up
workflow: Fill GitHub repo URL, project name, and a ≤200-char description
Optionally add website, 'Replaces' target, category, and email; newsletter opt-in checkbox present
Click 'Submit project' and wait for manual review
watchFor: Only meaningful if the product is open source — closed-source SaaS does not qualify
Footer shows 'Powered by Startup Fast' and cross-promo badges (Startup Fame, Wired Business) — a network of related launch sites
Email field is optional; leaving it blank means no notification path
countsAsLive: The project appears on opensourceprojects.cc under its category and/or in the alternatives list for the commercial product it replaces
unknowns: Whether rejected submissions receive a response
